summary: Independent read-only audit found the backend plan complete and ready to freeze against the published dev baseline.

findings.message: All required plan files, requirements, acceptance criteria, evidence routes, budgets and audit gates are present and consistent.
The exact dev integration baseline is d79de677facf8b06290523f9589808069f6cf621 and is published at origin/dev.
Backend writes and read-only boundaries are disjoint and include the tracked internal deployment document and root verification scripts.
Environment-only secrets, cookie JWT, refresh rotation, CSRF/origin checks, role boundaries and negative security tests are explicit.
Deterministic backend verification, Compose config, bounded health/auth smoke and explicit UNAVAILABLE handling are specified.
Frontend wiring and local-model verification remain outside this package; implementation remains unauthorized until execution is separately started.
